title: Program.Procedure — the procedure document
description: The authoring contract for a procedure definition. Stored whole in config.DefinitionVersion.PayloadText. An authored document may carry expressions as grammar-1 text; on approval the engine parses each to its canonical AST, and the canonical document is what is stored and hashed. This schema is the contract a later friendly editor targets. See docs/design/PROCEDURE-ENGINE.md.

g.description: Grammar generation of every embedded expression.

subjectKind.description: What one run of this procedure is about. Facts in expressions resolve against it unless a foreach rebinds the subject.

inputs.description: Named values bound when the instance starts — by the invoking workflow (bind), a call block (bind), or the person starting it. Referenced in expressions as input.<name>.

roles.description: Role aliases used by steps. Each maps to a security.Role code and may add a competency requirement — a grammar-1 boolean over person.* facts, evaluated for the person attempting the step.

requires.description: Boolean over person.* facts. Unknown refuses — a person whose competency cannot be established may not perform the step.

outcomes.description: The procedure's outcome vocabulary. Default ["Completed","Cancelled"]. A workflow guard may require a named outcome.

id.description: Unique within the document. Facts such as step.outcome[id='CHECK'] cite it.

expression.description: A grammar-1 expression. Authored as text; stored as the canonical AST object (FORMULA-GRAMMAR.md §8).

cadence.description: A grammar-1 cadence (FORMULA-GRAMMAR.md §6). Authored as text; stored canonical. Due instants are derived on read, never stored.

duration.description: A grammar-1 duration literal in text form.

refKind.description: For ref and set-of-ref: what is referenced.

allowed.description: For text: the closed list of values.

validate.description: Boolean over `value` plus the subject's facts. Unknown refuses the commit (FORMULA-GRAMMAR.md §5).

block.description: One block. The body of a procedure is a tree of these. Block-structured: no arbitrary edges.

step.description: A unit of work a person performs and commits. Commit produces a record.Record. Delivers: data capture, role and competency, sign-off, evidence, due date, deviation.

instruction.description: What the person does. Shown on the step; carried into the record.

role.description: A role alias from the document's roles map.

precondition.description: Boolean. The step cannot be started until this is true. Unknown holds it for a person and names the unknown facts. Delivers: guards and preconditions — e.g. approval cannot start until step.outcome[id='CHECK'] = 'Pass'.

capture.description: Typed fields captured at this step. Held as a draft until commit; then written as characteristic values on the record. Referenced afterwards as step.capture[id=…, field=…].

record.description: What the commit produces. Every step produces a record.Record; this names its kind and, where the kind has one, its template.

template.description: CharacteristicSchema.RecordTemplate key, where the kind is templated.

outcomes.description: The step's outcome vocabulary, chosen by the person at commit. Default ["Done"]. Referenced as step.outcome[id=…].

signoff.description: The commit is an attested act. `action` names the segregation action (Program.SegregationRule matches actionA/actionB on the procedure instance); `witness` requires a second attributed person.

evidence.description: Files bound to the record at commit.

due.description: When this step is due. Derived on read from the cadence and the anchor — never stored.

anchor.description: The step whose commit instant is the event / anchor. Default: the instance start.

escalation.description: As Program.NotificationType: after a duration past due, notify a role.

deviation.description: Whether the person may deviate, and what it costs. A deviation always requires a reason and always produces a record.Finding on the instance.

findingCategory.description: ref.FindingCategory code for the finding raised.

produces.description: On commit, create an entity and bind it to a procedure-scoped name (decision #52). Referenced afterwards as procedure.<as>. The REQUEST step of a settings change produces the settings-issue package.

branchOutcome.description: For a named step outcome, end the enclosing foreach member or parallel branch with a branch outcome, skipping its remaining steps (decision #51). The join counts the branch as complete. Keys are this step's outcomes; values are branch outcome codes such as Superseded. This is how a precondition that can never become true is avoided: every step with a precondition sits in a branch that some branchOutcome can end.

advances.description: On commit, fire a transition on a workflow instance — the procedure-to-workflow direction of the join (FR-2.1). The transition's own roles and guards still apply.

subject.description: A Reference-valued expression naming the workflow subject. Default: this procedure's subject.

transition.description: The transition name in that workflow.

onOutcome.description: Only when the step's outcome is this. Default: any.

sequence.description: Items run in order. Delivers: ordered steps.

parallel.description: Branches run concurrently and rejoin. Delivers: parallel branches. The legacy system's three completion tracks are one of these.

applies.description: Boolean. A branch whose condition is false is recorded NotApplicable and counts as joined. Unknown holds the branch open for a person to decide.

join.description: "all" — every branch complete or not applicable; "any" — the first completion proceeds and the rest are cancelled; an integer n — n completions.

choice.description: The first case whose condition is true runs. Delivers: conditional branching. All cases Unknown holds the choice for a person; none true and no else → the block completes with nothing run.

foreach.description: The body runs once per member of a set, each as its own branch with the subject rebound to the member. Delivers: iteration over a set. The eleven relays in one package.

over.description: A Set-of-Reference expression, evaluated once when the block starts.

as.description: The member's name for the outer scope, e.g. in join conditions and in facts such as foreach.outcome[id=…, member=…].

subjectKind.description: What each member is. Facts inside the body resolve against the member.

repeat.description: The body runs, then runs again until the condition is true. Delivers: rework without an arbitrary back-edge. Each pass is its own set of step instances; earlier passes stay committed and visible.

until.description: Boolean, evaluated after each pass. Unknown holds for a person.

max.description: After this many passes the block holds for a person rather than looping again.

call.description: Runs another procedure as a child instance. Delivers: sub-procedures. The callee's version is pinned when the parent instance starts — the whole tree is one version set.

hold.description: Work legitimately stops and waits. Delivers: hold points and suspension. The instance is Held, not abandoned, and reports as such.

until.description: Boolean. When true the hold releases itself. Absent: a person releases it.

releaseRole.description: Who may release it by hand. Default: the procedure's starting role.

maxDuration.description: Past this the hold is reported overdue and escalates as a step would.
